test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who became the first Indian to bag a medal at the IBSA Judo Grand Prix, in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Parmar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India won its first ever medal at the IBSA Judo Grand Prix, held in Nur Sultan, Kazakhstan.
 
• The Indian Blind and Para Judo Association’s Judoka Kapil Parmar won the bronze medal in the event.
